_notes: Sheet 176 of the tournament savegame (8x4, the Leonardo deck: its own FaceURL, the same DeckID 176 as Medusa's), read card by card from the image on 2026-11-01. CardID = 17600 + idx; 363 = character card (sheet 3, 10x7, position 63).

Hero card (read from the image): LEONARDO, MELEE, START HEALTH 16, MOVE 2; sidekick SPLINTER, MELEE, START HEALTH 9. TEAM TACTICS reads 'At the start of your turn, you may move any fighter 1 space.' (unmatched-memory omits the 'you may').

Fighter restrictions from the card bands: LEONARDO on Katana, Turtle power!, Wise beyond his years, Heroes in a half shell and Leonardo leads (11 cards); SPLINTER on Spatial awareness and Protective father (5 cards); ANY on the other 14.

Discrepancies with unmatched-memory: the real title is 'Eat, sleep, and breathe ninjutsu' (memory: 'breath', kept in memory_title so the importer finds the card); 'I have a plan' reads 'If you do' (memory: 'Of you do') and Fearless leader reads "this card's value" (memory: 'this card value'): the sheet's text wins.
TEAM TACTICS stays as data here; the interpreter runs the `team_tactics` trigger of data/heroes/effects/leonardo.json.
